about: THE FLOW OF THE BLADE: which blow follows which, by where the last one left the blade. Read by game.js (afFlowPick) and by the char editor's COMBO panel; measured by tools/realmesh/base/flow.js. Frames are the game clips' own, 30 fps. after.<blow> = ranges [frames past its landing, the blow that follows from there, the frame of THAT clip to take it up at]; past the last range he is back in his guard and open.<stance> says how he opens: a tap, or a press held into a heavy (heavyFrom: the frame of the heavy to take up, by the light whose wind-up the hold had begun). A heavy never chains into a heavy.
